description: Attaches a raster mask from a grayscale image (white reveals, black hides) to a layer, or removes the existing mask. The mask is stretched over the layer's own rectangle.

layer.description: Layer UUID or its exact name

maskPath.description: Grayscale or any image; luminance becomes coverage. Omit to clear the mask.

path.description: Path to the .comp project package (a directory ending in .comp)

name: set_layer_mask
title: Set or clear a layer mask
